progressionBeats: Earn first wood from Log Yard.
Buy Sharper Axe near the one-minute mark.
Unlock Hire Mill Workers and open Prestige Ridge.
Reach Prestige Mill by the target session end.

sessionPacing.earlyGame: Spawn in Starter Grove, learn income, and buy the first upgrade within 45–90 seconds.
sessionPacing.midGame: Route through Sawmill Shop to add automation and unlock the gated area.
sessionPacing.lateGame: Use Prestige Ridge for prestige/rebirth setup and creator handoff checks.
